name: colson-arch-theme
description: Omarchy-grade theming for GNOME on Arch Linux and any GNOME distro: 133 themes, 660 wallpapers, generated GNOME Shell + GTK theming, Ghostty/Neovim/btop, live-preview picker, wallpaper rotation, day/night scheduling, true-black Graphite base.

scripts.test: python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bin/theme').read())" && bin/theme --version && bin/theme help >/dev/null && bin/theme completions zsh >/dev/null
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('\ncolson-arch-theme installed. Next:  theme install   (then log out/in once)\n')"

author: Colson (@colson0x1)
